findings.description: The KMS key used for audit trail/log bucket encryption does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. For a long-lived key protecting audit data this extends the window in which a compromised key can decrypt all historical records.

No policy argument is specified, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy that grants the entire account root principal full access to the key (kms:* for arn:aws:iam::<account>:root), allowing any IAM principal in the account that can be granted access to use or administer this audit key. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict encrypt/decrypt and administrative actions to specific roles.
